symptom: Commands run against the new build wrote into ~/.hermes, the old estate.
root_cause: hermes_constants.py:59 defaults HERMES_HOME to Path.home()/'.hermes'. Any bare `hermes` call in the new tree silently used the old home.
class: Any tool whose target is an environment variable with a default will hit the default the one time nobody sets it.

lesson.statement: Never call a tool that takes its target from the environment without a wrapper that sets the target.

symptom: The new build's worktree contained 10966 files from the old estate.
root_cause: A worktree of an existing branch carries that branch's tree. 'New branch' was read as 'new work', not 'empty tree'.
class: Any branch created off a populated history starts populated, so 'start clean' needs an explicit emptying step.

lesson.statement: When the instruction is start from nothing, prove the tree is empty before the first commit.

root_cause: Unknown. Not yet investigated. The app answers, so it is running; the path is not documented anywhere in the repo.
class: Any service whose health path is not written down will be reported down by the next thing that probes it.

lesson.statement: A service with no recorded health path is an open question, not an incident. Ask once, record the answer.

symptom: The first WATCH run died: HTTP 402 from OpenRouter, 'requires more credits'. Requested 64000 tokens, could afford 1239.
root_cause: OPENAI_BASE_URL points at OpenRouter and the model string 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5' routed there. The OpenRouter account has no credit. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was present and working the whole time.
class: Any estate configured with two providers will use the wrong one the moment nobody names which.

lesson.statement: Name the provider explicitly in config, at every level. A model string that implies a provider is not a choice, it is a default.
